They’re tough enough for stubborn messes and rinse clean every time – even eggs and cheese won’t stick. When it’s time to refresh your sponge, simply place it in the top rack of your dishwasher. You can sanitize and clean them this way 20X or more! Scotch-Brite cleaning supplies give you the power to quickly clean up life’s everyday messes – that’s why we’re America’s #1 selling scrub sponge brand.
